about: VERBAL Pitfall Bench — paired turn-level items. Each item holds one partial conversation and two candidate user turns for the same moment: one committing a pitfall, one taking the skilled alternative. The benchmark measures whether the simulator (a) detects the pitfall, (b) leaves the skilled turn alone, and (c) actually carries out the required contingent reaction on the following turn. Design follows PitfallBench (arXiv:2608.29481); the taxonomy is re-derived for workplace conversations.
